payload.focus: Sprint retro: async decision widget shipped, velocity 23 points highest this quarter, Zephyr integration as key unlock
payload.rationale: This sprint retro directly echoes the prior Sprint 4 Retro (2026-03-22): same 23-point velocity claim, same Zephyr integration as key unlock, same async decision widget. I expanded the prior retro document node (Sample_Sprint4Retro_20260322) and all positions it surfaced — ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, Sprint4ThesisProven, the velocity observation, the metric-anchor style observation, and the Zephyr rate-limit blocker — so the passes can bind this new retro to the existing record rather than minting duplicates. I also expanded the two core narratives (DecisionCaptureAtConsensus, DecisionsEvaporate) and the anti-Slack positioning narrative with its anti-pattern position, since the widget shipped is the product thesis made concrete. ContextPreservationNextSprint was included because this later retro (2026-09-02) may show whether that next-sprint focus was addressed. I deliberately did NOT expand pricing positions (PricingTwelveDollars, PricingTier25Plus) or the webhook architecture decision, since this short document touches none of those concepts.
